_replication.status: REPLICATION, not the published run. The published file experiments/logs/cikm_multipositive_last5_v4.json is left unchanged.
_replication.environment: conda env 'crystle' (sklearn 1.8.0, numpy 2.2.6, scipy 1.17.0), CPU only. The environment of the published run ('graphllm') no longer exists.
_replication.agreement: 90 of 102 published fields reproduce exactly. All 12 differences are in the Beauty oracle arm that reorders injected candidates by raw CF score: hit@10 36/309 -> 35/309 (one user), ndcg@10 .036075 -> .035757, map@10 .025464 -> .025399, and the derived gaps. The Beauty realistic arm, the ideal-placement ceiling, and all Movies and Electronics fields match exactly. Most likely cause is a near-tie among low CF scores resolved differently under a different numeric environment; unverified.
_replication.adds: per-user arrays aligned with user_id; paired Wilcoxon p-values (the published run nulled them through a tuple-unpack bug)
_replication.caveats: Beauty evaluates 309 users, not 500. The driver comment at the oracle sort describes a positive-item tie-break bonus that the code does not implement. Retrieval masks training-history items but the oracle re-sort does not, so injected repeat-purchase positives are scored with unmasked CF scores.
